preconditions.name: window_n0::install_took_strict_majority
preconditions.description: A strict majority of this interval arm's seeds installed above the competence floor (post_bc >= COMPETENCE_RESOURCE_FLOOR). An install that did not take is UNINFORMATIVE about retention; below this the arm reds ONLY ITSELF and never vacates a sibling arm.
preconditions.control: fraction of seeds with install_took=True in this arm, vs 0.5

criteria.name: resistance_grows_with_interval
criteria.note: effective_interval_margin = max(1.5 * sd_delta=0.595361, 0.05); sd_delta is the SD of the per-seed paired (max_N - min_N) retained_fraction delta. Replaces V3-EXQ-836b's fixed 0.15 literal per the project effect-size-gate convention.
